title: Grounding, Tools and Human Review
introduction: Useful AI applications combine a model with trusted information, constrained tools and appropriate human decisions.
learningOutcomes: Describe risks when a model can call tools.
Place human review according to consequence and uncertainty.

activities.question: What is the purpose of retrieval grounding?
options: Provide relevant source material for the current response
Guarantee the model is always correct
Train a new model for every question
activities.explanation: Retrieval supplies relevant external context, but the answer still needs evaluation.

activities.question: An AI agent should receive every available permission in case it needs one.
activities.explanation: Least privilege limits tools and data to what the task genuinely requires.

activities.question: Order a grounded answer workflow.

items.text: Check the answer against sources and policy
Generate an answer using that context

activities.explanation: Clarify, retrieve, generate with context, then verify the result.
